Question 15
?

Which of the following is equivalent to tanh⁡(−1w)?

a
1−e2/w1+e2/w
b
1+e2/w1−e2/w
c
1−e2w1+e2w
d
1+e2w1−e2w
e
1−2e1/w1+2e1/w
